**🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🟡 Minor** | **⚡ Quick win**

**Text over 4000 UTF-16 units rejects the whole page.**

`normalized-item` copies `:content` or `:text` without a length check. `shape/Item` limits `:text` to `[:string {:max 4000}]`, and ClojureScript counts UTF-16 code units. A Discord Nitro message can contain up to 4000 characters. If that message includes astral-plane emoji, it can exceed 4000 code units. In that case, `law/assert-shape! shape/Item` throws, and `source-failure` reports `:source-page-rejected`. In `:newest` mode, every poll then fails while that message is in the newest window. Other encounters from that source are not admitted during that time.

This has the same failure mode as the oversized media reference that was already fixed. Two fixes are possible:
- Omit the oversized row from admission while it still counts as a raw identity.
- Store a bounded excerpt with an explicit truncation flag.

Do not reject the whole page.

<summary>Sketch (omit the oversized row; keep its raw frontier)</summary>

```diff
--- "a/backend/src/cljs/knoxx/backend/domain/character/social_encounters.cljc"
+++ "b/backend/src/cljs/knoxx/backend/domain/character/social_encounters.cljc"
@@ -204,7 +204,8 @@
         author-id (:authorId row)
         item {:external-id external-id :author-id author-id
               :occurred-at (normalize-instant (if discord? (:timestamp row) (:createdAt row)))
-              :text (or (if discord? (:content row) (:text row)) "")
+              :text (let [text (or (if discord? (:content row) (:text row)) "")]
+                      (if (<= (count text) 4000) text ""))
               :self-output? (= author-id (get-in spec [:source :account-id]))
               :reactions (if discord? (discord-reactions row) (bluesky-reactions row))
               :media (->> (if discord? (discord-media row)
```

**Do not derive actor authority from payload fields.**

`effective-auth-context` falls back from `ctx` to `parsed[:auth-context]`. A direct-start request can therefore supply both `agent_spec.actor_id` and an actor-bearing `auth_context` when no server context exists. Equality checks alone are insufficient because the request can set both values to another actor. Use only the server-derived `ctx`; reject actor-scoped direct starts without it. When `ctx` exists, require the spec actor to match the authenticated actor before resolving authority.
